title: Hackathon Excellence Award
event: Edunet Hackathon in collaboration with IBM SkillsBuild on IBM Bob
description: Awarded for successfully showcasing an innovative project through Stage Presentation at the Edunet Hackathon in collaboration with IBM SkillsBuild on IBM Bob – Gujarat under the IBM SkillsBuild University Engagements Program. Recognized for outstanding project-based learning, creativity, and practical demonstration of emerging technologies leveraging IBM Bob, LangFlow, Agentic AI, IBM Granite, and IBM SkillsBuild.
